Eye On China

Chinese commentators see a political plot behind the Jensen Huang extramarital affair scandal

Chinese commentators suggest that Jensen Huang’s advocacy for continued access to the Chinese market, and his criticism of US chip restrictions may have made him a target of greater scrutiny.

Sana Hashmi

11 November, 2026 08:30 am IST

Follow Us:

-->

Facebook

X

LinkedIn

WhatsApp

Email

Copy Link

A photo shows NVIDIA CEO Jensen Huang with a woman confirmed by a Reuters source to be Alice Huang in Taipei, Taiwan released on June 7, 2024. Obtained by Reuters/via REUTERS

Stay updated with ThePrint:

Preferred Source

Google Discover

-->

A headline on the Chinese news website Guancha declared that “The hunt for Nvidia is beginning to close in.” It captures a growing narrative in Chinese commentary that the controversy over Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang’s extramarital affair with Alice Huang is being used by Washington and Wall Street to increase pressure on the chipmaker.

A viral Weibo post highlighted Alice Huang’s career at Chinese state broadcasters Hunan TV and CCTV News , HSBC Private Bank and CITIC Securities, before she became managing director of Singapore-based Megaspeed in 2023. Claims that she had links to China and used her relationship with Huang to obtain chip-related information and circumvent export controls have been dismissed on Chinese internet as unsubstantiated .

The affair sparked intense debate across the Chinese internet since 30 October , before Jensen Huang’s public apology to his wife, in which he confessed to cheating. Discussion has ranged from national security and Huang’s private life to Nvidia’s future. On Weibo, there are hashtags about Huang admitting to infidelity, along with views that his confession was addressed to Capitol Hill.

Show Full Article

Beyond Huang’s private life For most Chinese commentators, the controversy has moved well beyond Huang’s personal reputation. Jin Yan , a special contributor to Caijing Magazine , argued that Huang’s personal relationships now raise questions about national security, export controls, and the consequences could extend across the entire AI supply chain.

A Baijiahao commentary makes a similar distinction: the focus, it argues, is on reports of foreign intelligence targeting Huang, rather than his infidelity.

Others have focused on what the scandal reveals about Nvidia itself. A Weibo post argued that while Huang’s infidelity is a personal moral issue, it also exposes the company’s dependence on its founder. After three decades under his leadership, Nvidia has no publicly announced succession plan, with little indication that Huang intends to step down. The post suggests that Huang’s growing geopolitical exposure could prompt investors to reassess key-person risk and its implications for the company’s valuation.

Shen Yi, a professor of international politics at Fudan University, placed the controversy surrounding Huang within the broader United States-China technology competition. He argued that Nvidia faces a security challenge shaped by competing approaches in Washington. Democrats may seek to curb AI expansion through regulation, while Republicans focus on national security and technology controls. Although their methods differ, both approaches could constrain American technology companies.

This, according to Shen, exposes a broader contradiction in US policy: Washington wants to maintain American dominance in AI while restricting China’s access to advanced computing, even as US companies and investors have strong commercial incentives to pursue opportunities in the Chinese market.

Espionage claims and the China factor In Chinese commentary, the espionage allegations are viewed largely through the lens of US-China rivalry. Some see them as another way for Washington to put pressure on a US technology company with deep commercial interests in China.

One analysis argued that American media have distorted the story to promote a broader anti-China narrative. It points to the portrayal of Huang’s association with an Asian woman as a potential intelligence link, and his calls for easing chip restrictions as evidence of Chinese influence.

The author suggests that Huang’s ‘Chinese’ heritage and position on the Chinese market have made him a target of US hawks. The allegations, the analysis argued, are intended to pressure Silicon Valley, stoke security fears and undermine prospects for improved US-China relations.

Other Chinese commentators focus on what the allegations could mean for Nvidia, regardless of whether espionage is established. Chinese publication World Science Pioneer said that media reports linking the controversy to foreign intelligence and national security risks have attracted much of the attention. Even if an investigation finds no leakage of trade secrets, the episode could still lead US regulators, customers and business partners to impose stricter requirements on information security, conflict-of-interest reviews and external communications.

A commentator pointed to bipartisan agreement in Washington on preventing advanced computing power from secretly reaching China.

Another Baijiahao commentary sees the scrutiny of Nvidia as following a familiar US political playbook: first accusations of chip transshipment, now allegations of intelligence links.

“The goals may change, but the script remains the same,” it said, drawing parallels with the earlier targeting of Huawei.

The author argued that as China narrows the US technological lead in AI, Washington is increasingly using political pressure to obstruct its rival, reflecting anxiety about its own technological competitiveness.

The message to Nvidia, it concludes, is clear: “If you obediently follow orders and cut off ties with China, then we’ll let you off the hook.”

Why now? The politics behind the timing For some Chinese commentators, the timing of the espionage controversy is important. They see it against the backdrop of Washington’s shifting approach to semiconductor exports and the continuing struggle over China’s access to advanced chips.

One commentary argued that Nvidia is caught between selective easing of chip export restrictions to China and continued scrutiny of its compliance with export controls. Huang has repeatedly criticised US restrictions, arguing that they undermine American competitiveness and push China to accelerate its own technological development.

Huang’s public support for open-weight AI models, including Chinese models, has also put him at odds with Washington’s more hawkish approach. Against this backdrop, the Chinese commentator questions why the allegations have surfaced now, suggesting they reflect wider geopolitical tensions over Nvidia’s continued business ties with China.

Another comment takes the argument further. It suggests that linking Huang’s personal scandal to allegations of Chinese espionage serves several political objectives: weakening his influence in Washington, discouraging Silicon Valley executives from advocating a softer approach toward China, providing justification for tighter chip export controls, and reinforcing the China threat narrative ahead of a new Congress.

Not all the commentary sees the controversy as an attempt to damage Nvidia itself.

A Weibo post said that new Democrat lawmakers could use the affair to warn other major technology companies that corporate misconduct carries consequences, without necessarily seeking to undermine Nvidia.

Writing for Guancha , Li Limeng offered a broader interpretation, presenting the controversy as part of a struggle for control of the US AI industry. In this account, Democrat establishment elites are seeking to consolidate their influence over AI models, energy infrastructure and semiconductor production through political networks, corporate appointments and governance mechanisms.

Also read: India is not an ally on demand. Its foreign policy must answer to its own people

A personal scandal with wider consequences Chinese reactions to the affair are far from uniform. They range from concerns about corporate governance and national security to claims of political manoeuvring in Washington. Yet a recurring theme is that the controversy cannot be separated from the wider US-China technology rivalry.

Some commentators suggest that Huang’s advocacy for continued access to the Chinese market, and his criticism of US chip restrictions, may have made him a target of greater scrutiny. They suspect that Huang’s personal relationships are now being used against him and viewed through the lens of national security.

Some see the affair as a means of putting pressure on Huang and Nvidia, while narrowing the space for US-China technology cooperation. Others believe its consequences could extend beyond the company, affecting the rules governing technology leaders and the direction of the global AI industry. In this reading, what began as a personal scandal involving one of the world’s most prominent technology executives has become part of a much larger debate about the future of AI and the intensifying US-China rivalry.

Sana Hashmi, PhD, is a fellow at the Taiwan-Asia Exchange Foundation and George HW Bush Foundation for US-China Relations. She tweets @sanahashmi1. Views are personal.

(Edited by Ratan Priya)

item.title: アングル：米債券市場、ＡＩ関連債への熱冷める 政策瀬踏みムードに
item.description:
Gertrude Chavez-Dreyfuss
［ニューヨーク １０日 ロイター］ - 米債券市場で、人工知能（Ａ...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
アングル：米債券市場、ＡＩ関連債への熱冷める　政策瀬踏みムードに 11:57 配信

写真は米連邦議会議事堂と米国国旗。11月4日、ワシントンで撮影。REUTERS/Umit Bektas（ロイター） Gertrude Chavez-Dreyfuss

［ニューヨーク　１０日　ロイター］　 - 米債券市場で、人工知能（ＡＩ）ブーム関連の債券に対する投資心理が慎重に転じている。民主党が主導権を握ることになった米上下両院が、ＡＩ投資やデータセンター拡大のペース抑制に動くとの懸念が影を落としている。

ＩＣＥ・ＢｏｆＡ米企業債指数のデータによると、株価が急落した５日、米高利回り債の米国債とのクレジットスプレッドは３４８ベースポイント（ｂｐ）に拡大した。これは、トランプ大統領が世界中で関税措置を実施した１カ月後に当たる昨年５月以来の高水準だ。スプレッドは６日には３４２ｂｐに縮小した。

カタリスト・ファンズのシニア・ポートフォリオ・マネジャー、ラリー・ホルツェンターラー氏は「市場は現在、明らかに神経質になっている。高利回り債とローン市場の双方で、ある程度高いボラティリティーが継続しても驚きはない」と語る。

健全な企業ファンダメンタルズが引き続き市場を支えているものの、ＡＩ関連リスクの再評価がさらに進めば、規制強化を見越して高利回り債と投資適格債の両方でクレジットスプレッドが一段と拡大する可能性があると、アナリストやポートフォリオマネジャーらはみている。投資適格債のスプレッドは４日に９１ｂｐだったのが、５日には９３ｂｐに拡大した。

１月に議会過半数を握る民主党は、ＡＩシステムやデータセンター開発を対象とする一連の新法案を計画している。共和党のトランプ大統領はＡＩ技術に対する規則制定を求める声を繰り返し退けてきたが、同党が歴史的敗北を喫した中間選挙後の週末、安全対策（セーフガード）を設けることに柔軟な姿勢を示した。

「投資意欲はより慎重かつ選別的になっている」と、ソーンバーグ・インベストメント・マネジメントのポートフォリオマネジャー、アリ・ハッサン氏は言う。「政治的・規制的な監視の目が強まることで、開発業者から請負業者、サプライヤーに至るまで、（ＡＩ）チェーン全体でクレジットが見直されるだろう」と述べた。

＜投資意欲後退＞

データセンター関連債券の多くは、「ＢＢ」級および「シングルＢ」級の高利回り債に集中している。これらの債券はここ数週間、新たな圧力にさらされており、ハイテク株が売りを浴びた際には特にそうだった。アナリストによると、高利回り債市場の悪化を主導したのはシングルＢ級で、そのスプレッドは３５ｂｐ拡大して３６７ｂｐと、３月以来の高水準に達した。

一例として、格付け「Ｂプラス」のギャラクシー・ヘリオス・データセンターの債券は５日に額面１ドル当たり８９．２５セントまで下落し、利回りは７月下旬の発行時の９．８７５％から１３％へと上昇した。

ルーミス・セイレスのマチアセット・ポートフォリオマネジャー、ピーター・ヤヌリス氏は「ＡＩインフラの建設が失速すれば、サプライチェーン、電力会社、電気工事事業者、機器・機械、データセンター開発業者に打撃が及び、これら全てが二次的な影響を受けるだろう」と述べた。

投資家にとってより大きな懸念は、ＡＩ規制が経済成長に及ぼす影響だ。ＡＩとそれを支えるインフラへの投資は、情勢が不透明な中でも米経済が今年、成長を保つ原動力となってきた。

ＪＰモルガン・チェースのシニアエコノミスト、アビエル・ラインハート氏は「データセンター開発のペースが少しでも減速すれば、経済全体の設備投資を大幅に鈍化させる恐れがある」と話した。

＜発行ラッシュ一服で安堵感も＞

一部の投資家はＡＩ開発の減速について、短期的にはクレジット市場およびＡＩ企業自体にとって健全なことではないかと考えている。ＡＩ規制の強化は債券発行の減少を意味し、それが債券価格を下支えするはずだからだ。

ルーミス・セイレスのヤヌリス氏は「これまで経験してきた怒濤（どとう）のＡＩ債券発行ラッシュが多少和らぎ、市場は今後６―１２カ月にわたってこの移行期間を消化することができる」と語った。

ただ投資家はＡＩについて長期的な成長予測こそ再評価しているものの、建設が進んでいるプロジェクトに関連する借り入れや設備投資が即座に縮小する可能性はほとんどないとみている。

キャピタル・グループのポートフォリオマネジャー、カレン・チョイ氏は「政治および規制上の不透明感は、２０２８年から３０年（およびそれ以降）に影響をもたらす可能性がある。ただプロジェクトの多くはもう進行中で、資金拠出も確約済みなので、２７年の設備投資と発行額を大きく変化させる可能性は低い」と述べた。

より大きな問題は、政策変更がＡＩの長期的な見通しを有意に変え得るかどうかだと多くの投資家は言う。

フェドウォッチ・アドバイザーズのベン・エモンズ最高投資責任者（ＣＩＯ）は「ＡＩが減速することはない」と断言。「テキサス州で減速したとしても、別の州で顔を出し、続いていくだけだろう」と語った。

ロイター 関連リンク アングル：金価格、米国債利回り上昇でも4000ドル台維持　中銀の準備資産分散が下支え コラム：進む米中デカップリング、中国「保有米国債」の脅威減退か コラム：米国債の「ベーシス取引」、軟着陸は可能か 焦点：債務膨張の先進国に金融危機の芽、最も懸念される米・伊・英 コラム：米財務省の借入拡大、債務問題の大きさに比べれば単なるノイズ 11/11(水) 11:57 最終更新 ロイター

item.title: 原油先物、2カ月ぶり安値から反発 船舶攻撃続く
item.description:
Colleen Howe Jeslyn Lerh
［シンガポール １１日 ロイター］ - １１日アジア時間の原油先物は...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
原油先物、2カ月ぶり安値から反発　船舶攻撃続く 11:43 配信

ホルムズ海峡の船舶。９日、オマーンのムサンダムから撮影。REUTERS（ロイター） Colleen Howe　Jeslyn Lerh

［シンガポール　１１日　ロイター］ - １１日アジア時間の原油先物は、前日に付けた２カ月ぶりの安値から反発した。市場は、イラン戦争の緊張緩和への期待と、ホルムズ海峡で続く船舶攻撃への懸念の間で揺れ動いている。

また、ロシア北西部のバルト海沿岸にあるウスト・ルガの港湾地区でドローン（無人機）攻撃による火災が発生し、作業員３人が負傷。地元当局者が１１日に明らかにした。

０４２０ＧＭＴ（日本時間午後１時２０分）時点で、北海ブレント先物は１．０４ドル（１．１％）高の１バレル＝９２．５３ドル。米ＷＴＩ先物 は０．６７ドル（０．８％）高の８６．７１ドルとなった。

ワシントン近東政策研究所によると、１０月にホルムズ海峡と周辺海域で攻撃を受けた船舶は３７隻と、紛争が始まって以来の月間最多を記録。１１月もこれまでに１０件の攻撃が確認されている。

スパルタ・コモディティーズのシニアアナリスト、ジューン・ゴー氏は「外交交渉の先行き不透明感の中、ペルシャ湾の航路における船舶への攻撃が増加している」と指摘。原油価格の最大の決定要因は、外交合意に達するための米国の要求に対し、イランがどの程度聞く耳を持つかという点にあると付け加えた。

ＬＳＥＧのアナリストは１０日付のリポートで「たとえ合意が成立しても、海峡を通じた輸送量が増えるかどうかは、機雷の除去や保険料、さらには船主にそもそもリスクを取る意思があるかに左右される」と指摘。「その間も攻撃は減っていない」と記した。

原油価格は１０日、米当局者がイランへの追加軍事攻撃の必要性は低いとの認識を示したことを受け、当初３ドル超下落。その後、イラン当局者が米国との協議は行われていないと述べると、下げ幅を縮小した。

item.title: 日銀、2％目標の持続的・安定的実現へ適切な政策運営引き続き期待＝高市首相
item.description:
Yoshifumi Takemoto
［東京 １１日 ロイター］ - 高市早苗首相は１１日の参院本会議で、日銀が１０月...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
日銀、2％目標の持続的・安定的実現へ適切な政策運営引き続き期待＝高市首相 11:34 配信

高市早苗首相。都内の首相官邸で１０月代表撮影。REUTERS（ロイター） Yoshifumi Takemoto

［東京　１１日　ロイター］ - 高市早苗首相は１１日の参院本会議で、日銀が１０月の展望リポートで２％の物価目標の定着度合いを確認していくことが重要と記載していると言及した上で、引き続き日銀には物価安定目標の「持続的、安定的実現に向けて適切に金融政策を運営されるものと考えている」との期待を示した。立憲民主党の柴慎一議員に対する答弁。

柴氏は足元の物価上昇を踏まえ政府・日銀が脱デフレに向けて２０１３年に公表した「共同声明（アコード）」を見直す可能性などを質問した。首相は「過度なインフレを招くような経済政策を行うつもりはない」とも発言した。

安倍晋三政権発足直後の２０１３年以降掲げてきた２％物価目標について、日銀は１０月２９─３０日の金融政策決定会合でとりまとめた「経済・物価情勢の展望（展望リポート）」で、基調的な物価上昇率が２％目標と「おおむね整合的な水準になった」との認識を表明している。

item.title: Thune, Jordan emerge as Republican minority leaders for next US Congress
item.description: The Republicans will be the minority party in both chambers of Congress during the final two years of Trump's presidency.
item.dc:creator: CNA
item.content:encoded:
Advertisement

World

Thune, Jordan emerge as Republican minority leaders for next US Congress

The Republicans will be the minority party in both chambers of Congress during the final two years of Trump's presidency.

US Representative Jim Jordan (R-Ohio) speaks during a US House Judiciary subcommittee hearing on sanctuary city policies, on Capitol Hill in Washington, DC on Jun 30, 2026. (File photo: Reuters/Aaron Schwartz)

11 Nov 2026 10:13AM (Updated: 11 Nov 2026 10:15AM)

FAST

WASHINGTON: Republicans chose US Senate Majority Leader John Thune and House Judiciary Committee Chairman Jim Jordan on Tuesday (Nov 10) to lead them against a Democratic-controlled Congress that will take power in January for the final two years of Donald Trump's presidency. A week after Republicans lost their majority in a stinging midterm election defeat, Senate Republicans chose Thune by acclamation at a closed-door meeting for the task of trying to thwart Democratic initiatives that do not meet with their approval, including by wielding the Senate filibuster. "We're not going to be running this place next year," Thune told reporters. "But you can be assured we will be very, very active in asserting conservative priorities in all of the legislating ... that goes on here." Jordan's election as House minority leader elevates a combative Trump ally to the forefront of the party’s fight to defend the US president’s agenda in the lower chamber. Jordan defeated House Majority Leader Steve Scalise in a secret ballot. House Speaker Mike Johnson opted not to stand for the leadership position.

US Senate Majority Leader John Thune (R-South Dakota) speaks at a press conference on the day of the Senate Republican caucus leadership elections at the US Capitol in Washington, DC, on Nov 10, 2026. (File photo: Reuters/Elizabeth Frantz)

The House and Senate leadership elections will help to determine what role Republicans intend to play as the minority party in Congress during the final two years of Trump's presidency. Democrats will need Republican support to move major initiatives in the 100-member Senate, where the filibuster rule requires 60 votes for most legislation. Their majorities in both chambers also fall well short of the two-thirds of votes needed to override presidential vetoes. Thune, 65, a South Dakota Republican known for his consensus-building leadership style, is respected by Republicans and Democrats alike. But he has run afoul of Trump's MAGA supporters who say he did not move aggressively enough to enact Trump's policies on immigration and election reform. After the midterm elections, Thune vowed that Republicans would work with Trump to block "Democrat extremism" and work against any attempt by Democrats to unwind Republican achievements, including border security and judicial appointments. Jordan, 62, was first elected in 2006 to represent a deeply conservative rural district in northern Ohio and was a founder of the House Freedom Caucus, a group that former Republican House Speaker John Boehner labelled "legislative terrorists". Before entering politics, Jordan honed his pugilistic style during a career as a high school and university champion wrestler, and later as a wrestling coach at Ohio State University. That past threatened his political career in 2018 when former students accused him of turning a blind eye to rampant sexual abuse of college wrestlers by the wrestling team's doctor, when Jordan was an assistant coach. Jordan denied all allegations, and a university investigation found no hard evidence that he knew of the abuse. But former wrestlers said the doctor's abuse was well-known and the report itself found that students had complained about the doctor's voyeurism in front of coaching staff. Jordan has often referred to his wrestling background in terms of his reputation as a fighter in Congress. He is known for his aggressive style of questioning in committee hearings. "I look at it like a wrestling match," Jordan told the New York Times in an April 2023 interview, explaining how he prepares for hearings. "I'm going to try to get as ready as I can. You can't just wing it."

item.description: 米ウォール街賞与3年連続増へ、今年がピークの可能性＝コンサル会社 Reuters

item.title: 米ウォール街賞与3年連続増へ、今年がピークの可能性＝コンサル会社
item.description:
Tatiana Bautzer
[ニューヨーク １０日 ロイター] - 報酬コンサルティング会社ジョンソン・アソシエー...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
米ウォール街賞与3年連続増へ、今年がピークの可能性＝コンサル会社 11:11 配信

２０２１年７月、ニューヨーク証券取引所（ＮＹＳＥ）の外にあるウォール街の標識。米ニューヨークで撮影。REUTERS/Andrew Kelly（ロイター） Tatiana Bautzer

[ニューヨーク １０日 ロイター] - 報酬コンサルティング会社ジョンソン・アソシエーツによると、２０２６年は米ウォール街の賞与が３年連続で増える見通しだ。金利上昇と市場の変動から、今年記録的水準となった企業買収・資金調達案件業務とトレーディング収入の伸びを鈍化させ始めているものの、増加が見込まれている。

同社の推計によると、株式の営業、新規株式公開（ＩＰＯ）の引き受け、トレーディングに携わる銀行員の賞与は前年比２０─３０％増の見通し。Ｍ＆Ａ（合併・買収）助言業務の幹部報酬は１５─２０％増、債券の営業・トレーディング担当者は７．５─１２．５％増が見込まれている。

同社の創業者でマネジングディレクターのアラン・ジョンソン氏は、２６年は銀行員の報酬が過去最高となり、「銀行の年」として締めくくられる見通しだと述べた。

ＬＳＥＧのデータによると、今年１─９月の世界の投資銀行手数料収入は前年同期比９％増の９９４億ドルで、過去最高を記録した２１年以来の高水準となった。

ただ、ジョンソン氏は「２７年の利益は金利上昇、地政学的混乱、市場の変動の影響を受ける可能性があり、今年がピークになるかもしれない」と指摘。最近のハイテク株急落は、株価のバリュエーションが歴史的に見て非常に高いことを改めて示していると述べた。

一方、保険・資産運用会社の幹部賞与は前年並みか小幅増の見通し。業績連動報酬が減少する可能性があるのはプライベートクレジット部門のみで、解約請求の増加や融資先の破綻に伴う一部損失に直面している。

Oil rises from two-month low as Hormuz shipping attacks offset Iran truce hopes

FILE PHOTO: Vessels at the Strait of Hormuz, as seen from Musandam, Oman, October 19, 2026. REUTERS/Stringer/File Photo

FAST

BEIJING, Nov 11 : Oil prices rose on Wednesday after falling to two-month lows in the previous session, as the market swung between hopes for a de-escalation in the Iran war and concerns about ongoing attacks on shipping in the Strait of Hormuz. Brent futures climbed 71 cents, or 0.78 per cent, to $92.20 a barrel by 0119 GMT. US West Texas Intermediate (WTI) crude rose 49 cents, or 0.57 per cent, to $86.53. New data showed that 37 ships were attacked in the Strait of Hormuz and surrounding waterways in October, the highest monthly total since the start of the war, according to the Washington Institute for Near East Policy. And 10 attacks have been recorded so far in November. Videos posted on social media on Sunday and verified by Reuters showed a Navig8 tanker on fire near the coast of Oman, one of three tankers hit on Sunday for using "unauthorised routes" through the strait, according to the Iranian state broadcaster.

Another tanker was struck northeast of Oman's Lima, the United Kingdom Maritime Trade Operations (UKMTO) agency said on Tuesday. Iran's Revolutionary Guards Navy said in a separate statement on Tuesday that two tankers caught fire after hitting naval mines on the "unauthorized route" in the strait. "Even in the event a deal is struck, an increase in flows through the waterway would still depend on mine clearance, insurance costs and whether or not shipowners would even be willing to take the risk," LSEG analysts said in a November 10 note. "Meanwhile, attacks have not slowed." In the previous session, oil prices initially fell by more than $3 a barrel after US officials downplayed the need for further military strikes against Iran, but then gained back some of those losses after an Iranian security official said no talks were taking place between the two sides. US crude oil stocks rose in the latest week, market sources said, citing data from the American Petroleum Institute. Crude stocks rose by 9 million barrels in the week ended November 6, the sources said. In Russia, oil refining capacity has been reduced by about 30 per cent since late October following renewed Ukrainian drone attacks, industry sources said. Russian and Ukrainian officials met in Abu Dhabi on Tuesday for their first peace talks since February as US President Donald Trump's envoys launched a fresh push to end the war.

Source: Reuters

item.title: オープンＡＩ、チャットＧＰＴ「Businesses」ベータ版発表
item.description: [１０日 ロイター] - 米人工知能（ＡＩ）開発企業オープンＡＩは１０日、チャットＧＰＴ内で「Businesses」の...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
オープンＡＩ、チャットＧＰＴ「Businesses」ベータ版発表 11:00 配信

オープンＡＩのロゴ。11月6日撮影。REUTERS/Dado Ruvic（ロイター） [１０日 ロイター] - 米人工知能（ＡＩ）開発企業オープンＡＩは１０日、チャットＧＰＴ内で「Businesses」のベータ版をリリースすると発表した。これにより、企業は自社のプロフィールを登録・管理したり、情報を更新したり、チャットボット上でユーザーが自社とどのように関わり合っているかを追跡したりできるようになる。

• 「Business Hub」と呼ばれるツールを通じて、企業はチャットＧＰＴ上で自社のビジネスを登録でき、認証が完了すれば、主要な詳細情報を更新したり、価格や在庫状況を含む商品フィードを追加したりすることが可能になる。

• これによりメンション数、閲覧数、ウェブサイトへのクリック数などが集計されたインサイトも表示されるという。

• また、「Business Agents」と呼ばれる別のツールにより、ユーザーは企業のエージェントとチャットを行い、製品やサービスについて質問できるようになる。オープンＡＩは当初、この機能を米国内の適格な電子商取引・オンラインサービス事業者に提供する。

• オープンＡＩは、ユーザーの会話やBusiness Agentのチャット内容を企業と共有することはないと述べた。

item.title: Petrobras registra ganancias inferiores a las esperadas pese a producción récord y altos precios del petróleo
item.description: Las ganancias ajustadas de Petrobras antes de intereses, impuestos, depreciación y amortización se situaron en R$85.820 millones (US$15.400 millones), por debajo del promedio de R$95.590 millones esti ...
item.dc:creator: Mariana Durao
item.content:encoded: Bloomberg — Los beneficios de la petrolera estatal brasileña no alcanzaron las previsiones en el tercer trimestre, a pesar de la producción récord de petróleo y gas y de un contexto favorable de altos precios del crudo y sólidos márgenes de refinación. Las ganancias ajustadas de Petrobras antes de intereses, impuestos, depreciación y amortización se situaron en R$85.820 millones (US$15.400 millones), por debajo del promedio de R$95.590 millones estimado por Bloomberg . Esto representa un aumento del 34% con respecto al año anterior. Ver más: Petrobras eleva su producción a un récord y opera sus refinerías al 99% de capacidad La empresa petrolera ha estado realizando importantes inversiones para ampliar las plataformas de producción en los yacimientos marinos. Ha revisado al alza su objetivo de gasto de capital para 2026, situándolo entre US$24.000 y US$25.500 millones, frente a los US$19.400 millones previstos inicialmente. La empresa batió otro récord de producción en el trimestre al adelantar la puesta en marcha de nuevas unidades flotantes de producción y almacenamiento (FPSO) en alta mar y al hacer que las plataformas existentes superaran su capacidad nominal, lo que permitió aumentar la producción de barriles con un costo adicional mínimo. Asimismo, hizo funcionar sus refinerías casi a plena capacidad, con el diésel en máximos históricos, lo que ayudó a Brasil a enfrentar las perturbaciones en los mercados energéticos mundiales provocadas por la guerra de Irán. La empresa, con sede en Río de Janeiro, anunció un reparto de dividendos a los accionistas de US$2.7 mil millones, por debajo de la media de US$3.8 mil millones de tres estimaciones de analistas analizadas por Bloomberg . Los ingresos netos de Petrobras ascendieron a R$39.800 millones, según indicó en un comunicado el martes, un 21,5% por encima del mismo periodo del año anterior y por debajo de la previsión consensuada de R$46.620 millones. Los precios del petróleo han retrocedido este mes ante las expectativas de que la guerra pueda terminar pronto gracias a la vía diplomática. Aun así, los precios del Brent se han disparado casi un 50% este año y se han cotizado por encima de los US$100 durante gran parte de 2026. El conflicto de Medio Oriente y los ataques ucranianos contra Rusia han dejado fuera de servicio alrededor del 10% de la capacidad mundial de refino, lo que ha elevado los márgenes de las plantas que siguen operativas. Ver más: De Nubank a Petrobras: acciones de Brasil se desploman y bolsa tiene su mayor caída en seis años La restricción de la oferta ha supuesto una ganancia inesperada para las grandes petroleras y ha impulsado una subida de los precios. Las acciones de Petrobras han superado a las de sus homólogas internacionales este año, incluso después de que la sorprendente reelección del político de izquierda Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva desencadenara una ola de ventas en los mercados brasileños. Petrobras ha subido más de un 43% en dólares este año, superando a rivales como Shell Plc ( SHEL ), ExxonMobil Holdings Corp. ( XOM ) y Chevron Corp. ( CVX ). Petrobras tiene previsto dar a conocer su próximo plan de negocio quinquenal a finales de este mes. Si bien la estrategia debería seguir centrada en impulsar la exploración y la producción de petróleo —principalmente mediante la incorporación de nuevos pozos y plataformas a su gigantesco yacimiento de Búzios y el avance de la exploración en la cuenca de Foz do Amazonas—, también se espera que la empresa se expanda aún más allá de su actividad principal durante el próximo mandato de Lula. Ver más: Sheinbaum espera que avance la colaboración de Pemex y Petrobras tras elecciones en Brasil La CEO, Magda Chambriard, está dando prioridad al refinado para alcanzar la autosuficiencia en diésel, al tiempo que invierte en biocombustibles y otros negocios con bajas emisiones de carbono. La empresa también está ampliando su actividad en el sector de los fertilizantes, con la vista puesta en volver a la distribución de combustible y explorando oportunidades en fase inicial en el ámbito de los minerales críticos y las tierras raras. El plan de US$109.000 millones para el periodo 2026-2030, anunciado hace un año, se basaba en un precio del petróleo de entre US$63 y US$70 por barril, mientras que el crudo Brent cotiza actualmente cerca de los US$90. También se espera que Petrobras eleve sus previsiones de producción de petróleo. El martes, aumentó su objetivo de producción para 2026 hasta los 2,8 millones de barriles diarios, desde los 2,5 millones anteriores. Lea más en Bloomberg.com

item.description:

［ミュンヘン １０日 ロイター］ - 人工知能（ＡＩ）関連需要が、自動車や産業機器の生産...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
ＡＩ需要が自動車や産業機器の生産圧迫、欧州半導体2社が「ボトルネック」指摘 10:49 配信

11月９日、ミュンヘンで行われた見本市のカンファレンスで登壇した ＳＴマイクロエレクトロニクスのジャンマルク・シェリーＣＥＯら。 REUTERS/Nathan Vifflin（ロイター） Nathan Vifflin

［ミュンヘン　１０日　ロイター］ - 人工知能（ＡＩ）関連需要が、自動車や産業機器の生産を圧迫──。欧州の半導体メーカー、ネクスペリアとＳＴマイクロエレクトロニクスのトップが指摘した。ＡＩ投資ブームが半導体サプライチェーンの他の部分でボトルネックを生んでいることを改めて示した。

ネクスペリアは主に自動車や産業用機器に使われる大量生産の汎用型半導体を手掛ける。ＳＴマイクロも、自動車、産業用機器、通信機器など向けの製品を提供している。

ネクスペリアのステファン・ティルガー暫定最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）は、エレクトロニクス関連見本市が開催されたドイツ・ミュンヘンでロイターの取材に応じ、「（受注が）供給能力を大幅に上回っている」と述べた。競合するメーカーの一部が生産品目を、急成長しているＡＩデータセンター向けに移行させたため、自動車や産業機器向けの製品でボトルネックが生じていると指摘し、「自動車業界は現在、かなり深刻な打撃を受けている」と語った。

ＳＴマイクロエレクトロニクスのジャンマルク・シェリーＣＥＯは開幕に先駆けて９日に行われたパネル討議で、ファウンドリー（受託生産）や半導体パッケージを手がける企業が、重点分野を自動車や産業用途からＡＩデータセンターやロボティクスへ移行しているとし、「多くのボトルネックが見られる」と述べた。

ティルガー氏は、ＡＩデータセンターやロボット向けの需要が生産能力を吸収していると述べた。一方、ダイオードやトランジスタなどの基本的な部品に使われる成熟技術への投資は、長年にわたり後回しにされてきたとした。

シェリー氏は、以前は幅広い顧客向けの製品を提供していたファウンドリーや、半導体の組み立てやパッケージを手がける企業も「主流の技術から撤退しつつある」と指摘した。

その上で、ＳＴマイクロは自社で製造拠点を持っているため、供給制約の影響をある程度抑えられていると説明。「設備投資と自社製造により、将来の一部を自らコントロールしている」と語った。

Pope Leo draws million-strong crowd at Argentine vigil, urges youth not to chase clicks

Reuters

11 November, 2026 07:00 am IST

By Joshua McElwee BUENOS AIRES, Argentina, Nov 10 (Reuters) – Pope Leo drew a crowd of a million on Tuesday for the third strong turnout of his 12-day South America tour, as he urged young people at a nighttime vigil in Argentina not to be consumed by the pursuit of money or social media popularity.

Throngs stretched for miles down the Avenida del Libertador, one of Buenos Aires’ main boulevards. Many waved cell phones, screens shining in the black night, as Leo was driven slowly through the crowd in an open-air popemobile.

Chants of “This is the pope’s youth!” rang out as the vehicle stopped frequently so security officials could bring forward babies for Leo to bless.

Show Full Article

In a speech, the pope warned young people against worship of modern-day “idols” such as success or physical appearance, and lamented that some youth “go so far as to lie, betray or humiliate someone on social media.”

“Do not bow down before anything that cannot give you life,” he said.

Leo, on an ambitious three-country tour through November 17, led the vigil after returning from a day trip to Cordoba, Argentina’s second city, where he drew 650,000 people to an outdoor Mass earlier on Tuesday.

The pope led a Mass on Monday at the Avenida del Libertador that drew 2.5 million people, in the largest event of his 18-month-old papacy.

POPE SEEKS TO SHORE UP CATHOLIC STRONGHOLD

Leo is the first pope to visit Catholic-majority Argentina since 1987.

The pope, who is also visiting Uruguay and Peru on the tour, is seeking to reinforce a region that has long been a Catholic stronghold but where the Church has been losing ground to fast-growing evangelical denominations.

Leo has emerged as a forceful voice on the world stage, lamenting what he sees as a failure of global leadership. In Argentina, he has directly challenged President Javier Milei, a libertarian and close ally of US President Donald Trump.

On Sunday, Leo urged Milei, who has pushed an austerity agenda that the Church has criticized for cutting social services, not to target Argentina’s poorest. Milei has said spending cuts were necessary to bring inflation under control.

Valentin Gomez, 21, a student attending the Mass in Cordoba, praised Leo’s focus on those in need.

“In these difficult times we are living through, he is greatly needed,” Gomez said. “Someone who is truly concerned about the poor.”

Cordoba Cardinal Angel Sixto Rossi, a critic of the austerity policies, welcomed Leo’s visit as a chance for the pope to see how Argentina is suffering under Milei’s measures.

“He knows how beautiful our people are and the ugly part, the leadership of the government,” he said in an interview with Argentine media. “He doesn’t arrive blindfolded.”

Argentine Foreign Minister Pablo Quirno said Cordoba was chosen as a stop on the pope’s tour because of its location in the center of Argentina, allowing pilgrims to travel easily from neighboring provinces.

Leo, the first US-born pope, spent decades as a missionary in Peru. The Vatican has described the trip, one of the most demanding foreign tours by a pope in decades, as a “homecoming” for him.

(Reporting by Joshua McElwee, additional reporting by Leila Miller, Lucila Sigal, Horacio Soria; editing by Chizu Nomiyama, Rod Nickel and Stephen Coates)

WASHINGTON, Nov 10 (Reuters) – US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent recently moved out of his home and onto a military base after Iranian threats against his life, the New York Times reported on Tuesday, citing sources with knowledge of the matter.

Iran has ramped up efforts to target US personnel, and lethal plots by Tehran against American citizens have reached “advanced stages”, a senior intelligence official in the Trump administration warned in a memo seen by Reuters late last month.

The newspaper reported that the severity of the threats to Bessent was not immediately clear.

Show Full Article

Iran has previously denied plotting to attack officials and people on US soil.

The newspaper reported that US officials have noted that Iran’s ability to carry out large-scale attacks in the US and other territories overseas is limited.

The US Treasury Department did not immediately respond to a request for comment.

Bessent has been the face of Washington’s economic pressure campaign against Tehran during the course of the US-Israeli war on Iran that began on February 28.

US-Israeli strikes on Iran and Israeli attacks on Lebanon during the war have killed thousands and displaced millions.

American and Israeli attacks have also killed top Iranian officials, including late Supreme Leader Ayatollah Ali Khamenei.

(Reporting by Kanishka Singh in Washington; editing by Michelle Nichols )

item.content:encoded:
米ＩＢＭ、コンサル部門職務の大半でビザ・グリーンカード支援終了 10:20 配信

IBMのロゴ。3月にバルセロナで撮影。 REUTERS/Nacho Doce（ロイター） [１０日 ロイター] - 米ＩＢＭは１０日、１５万人以上を雇用するＩＢＭコンサルティングにおける職務の大半について、米国のビザ（査証）・グリーンカード（永住権）のスポンサーシップを終了すると発表した。

外国人技術者の採用に対するトランプ政権の監視が強化される中、今回の措置が発表された。

ＩＢＭコンサルティングは、人材不足を解消するために米国の高度技能ビザプログラムを活用してきたが、その利用はここ数年減少傾向にあったと説明。人材の供給状況や顧客のニーズが変化したことを受け、こうした職務のほとんどについてスポンサーシップを終了することを決定したと付け加えた。

ブルームバーグ・ニュースは社内文書を基に、この措置の影響を受ける従業員は、米国外で勤務するか、年末までに退職する選択肢があると報じている。

item.content:encoded:
マネーストックＭ３、10月は0.9％増　預金減で昨年8月以来の1％割れ 9:45 配信

写真は円紙幣のイメージ。10月20日撮影。REUTERS/Kim Kyung-Hoon（ロイター） Takahiko Wada

［東京　１１日　ロイター］ - 日銀が１１日に発表した１０月のマネーストック速報によると、Ｍ３の平均残高は前年比０．９％増の１６３３兆２０００億円だった。残高、伸び率ともに前月を下回った。伸び率は２０２５年８月以来の１％割れ。金融機関の貸出増が続く一方で、個人を中心に預金が徐々に減っている。

内訳では、預金通貨が０．２％減の９６８兆４０００億円となる一方、定期預金などを含む準通貨は４．４％増の５３５兆７０００億円と高い伸びを維持している。現金通貨は１．５％減と、引き続き前年比マイナス。

Ｍ２は１．７％増の１２９１兆４０００億円で、伸び率は前月を下回った。

広義流動性は４．１％増の２３４１兆２０００億円。残高は８カ月ぶりに前月を下回った。国債は２０．４％増の４９兆７０００億円、外債は３．１％増の３２兆６０００億円。広義流動性の速報値はデータが集まらない計数もあり、来月以降に値が修正される可能性がある。

＊日銀の発表資料は以下のＵＲＬをダブルクリックしてご覧下さい。

item.title: シカゴ連銀総裁「深刻なインフレ問題が進行」、経済過熱に懸念
item.description: [１０日 ロイター] - 米シカゴ地区連銀のグールズビー総裁は１０日、この日発表された最新のインフレ統計について、基...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
シカゴ連銀総裁「深刻なインフレ問題が進行」、経済過熱に懸念 9:43 配信

写真は米シカゴ地区連銀のグールズビー総裁。5月6日、米カリフォルニア州ビバリーヒルズで撮影。REUTERS/Mike Blake（ロイター） [１０日 ロイター] - 米シカゴ地区連銀のグールズビー総裁は１０日、この日発表された最新のインフレ統計について、基調的な動向に改善が見られず、「懸念を覚えるほどの内容だ」と述べた。特に、物価上昇圧力がエネルギー価格や人工知能（ＡＩ）以外にも広がっているとみられることを問題視した。

公共放送ＰＢＳの番組「ニュースアワー」のインタビューで、「サービス価格のインフレは低下しておらず、その大部分は原油価格や関税、あるいは一時的かもしれない要因によるものではないだろう。深刻なインフレ問題が進行しており、われわれはそれに対処しなければならない」と述べた。

「私が懸念しているのは、経済全体の過熱へと広がり始めていることだ。サービスを含む幅広い分野で物価があまりに速く上昇しており、そのペースはわれわれのインフレ目標である２％を大きく上回っている」と語った。

米労働省が１０日発表した１０月の消費者物価指数（ＣＰＩ）は前月比０．４％上昇した。食品や住居費の上昇を背景に市場予想（０．３％）を上回った。

Nov 11 (Reuters) – Russia shot down 92 drones early on Wednesday in an attack over the Leningrad region northwest of Moscow, Governor Aleksandr Drozdenko said on the Telegram messaging app.

The region is home to the ports of Ust-Luga, Primorsk and Vysotsk, key for Russia’s oil and grain exports on the Baltic Sea, as well as the Kirishi oil refinery, Russia’s second-largest.

Reuters could not immediately independently confirm the report.

Show Full Article

On Monday, a drone struck the Kirishi refinery, run by Surgutneftegaz, setting the plant on fire, and killed a woman in the region where St Petersburg, the hometown of President Vladimir Putin, is located.

Neighbours Latvia and Lithuania warned people to seek shelter against the threats of unidentified drones entering their airspace via Russia or Belarus, and said NATO air defence fighter jets were activated.

In Ukraine, power went out in part of the central city of Kryvyi Rih, an industrial stronghold and hometown of President Volodymyr Zelenskiy, after a drone attack, an official said on Telegram.

The attacks come as the United States attempts a new peace push at the first Russia-Ukraine talks in nine months in Abu Dhabi, set to continue on Wednesday.

(Reporting by Georgina McCartney in Houston;Editing by Jekaterīna Golubkova and Clarence Fernandez)

item.description:

item.content:encoded:
ＢＭＷ、供給網の問題で独英3工場の生産に影響 9:26 配信

写真はＢＭＷのロゴ。2025年2月、オランダのナイメーヘンで撮影。REUTERS/Piroschka van de Wouw（ロイター） Rachel More

［ベルリン　１０日　ロイター］ - ドイツ自動車大手ＢＭＷの広報担当者は１０日、サプライチェーン（供給網）の問題が３工場の生産に影響を及ぼし、シフト体制の調整につながっていると明らかにした。問題解決にサプライヤー各社と取り組んでいるという。

• ＢＭＷはドイツのライプツィヒとレーゲンスブルク、英国のオックスフォードにある工場で「課題」に直面している。

• ドイツ通信社（ＤＰＡ）と独誌シュピーゲルがこの問題について最初に報じた。報道によると、シフトが１回キャンセルされるごとに数百台の車両の生産に影響が出る可能性がある。

• ＢＭＷ広報担当者は生産への影響の規模やどの部品が不足しているかについてはコメントを差し控えた。供給をできるだけ早く確保するためにサプライヤー各社と連絡を取り合っているという。

日経平均は高寄り後もみ合い、材料難　米コアウィーブ好決算には安心感 9:24 配信

写真は4月6日、東京証券取引所で撮影。REUTERS/Issei Kato（ロイター） [東京 １１日 ロイター] - 寄り付きの東京株式市場で日経平均は、前営業日比０．１１％（６５円７２銭）高の６万０５２５円３０銭と、続伸してスタートした。前日の米国株式市場は軟化したが、注目されていた米新興クラウドのコアウィーブの決算が好調だったことが安心感をもたらした。ただ、高寄りした後は決め手になる材料を欠き、前日終値付近でもみ合う展開。

個別では、三菱ＵＦＪフィナンシャル・グループなどの銀行株やファーストリテイリングがしっかり。半面、アドバンテストが小安く、ソフトバンクグループは売り気配で始まった。

item.title: Rotación por caída de acciones de IA: India vive su mejor semana desde 2021 y América Latina atrae inversores
item.description: Inversores destacan las empresas de servicios públicos sudamericanas, los fabricantes de bienes de consumo chinos y taiwaneses, y las entidades financieras de Europa Central y del Este como alternativ ...
item.dc:creator: Mpho Hlakudi, Leda Alvim
item.content:encoded: Bloomberg — Los inversores que buscan un respiro de la turbulencia generada por la IA en los mercados bursátiles mundiales están centrando su atención en las oportunidades que ofrecen los mercados emergentes. La creciente inquietud en torno a la inteligencia artificial ha afectado duramente al principal índice MSCI de países en desarrollo, ya que los gigantes de los semiconductores SK Hynix Inc. ( SKHY ), Samsung Electronics Co. y Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Co. ( TSM ) representan en conjunto casi el 30% del índice. Estas acciones arrastraron al índice a su nivel más bajo en siete meses el viernes, antes de recuperarse. Ver más: Las empresas de América Latina adoptan la IA, pero aún no logran medir su impacto económico Sin embargo, más allá de la tendencia relacionada con la IA, los gestores de fondos afirman que ven una oportunidad de beneficiarse de las valoraciones en mínimos históricos y de las elevadas rentabilidades por dividendos en los mercados emergentes, que, según un indicador, se encuentran en su nivel más bajo desde la crisis financiera mundial de hace 18 años. “Acaparar tres o cuatro empresas y estar muy concentrados no funciona a largo plazo”, afirmó Sat Duhra, gestor de cartera de Janus Henderson Investors. “Hay muchos otros sectores, además de la IA, que han funcionado muy bien, y ahí es donde nos hemos posicionado”. Duhra declaró el viernes que ha estado incorporando acciones de mayor rentabilidad en China y Hong Kong, citando una “mejora en la disciplina de reparto de dividendos”. Si bien Hong Kong se clasifica como un mercado desarrollado, una gran parte de las empresas que cotizan allí tienen su sede en China. “Todavía no nos vemos tentados a aumentar nuestra exposición al sector tecnológico”, afirmó. Otros inversores destacan las empresas de servicios públicos sudamericanas, los fabricantes de bienes de consumo chinos y taiwaneses, y las entidades financieras de Europa Central y del Este como alternativas atractivas a las acciones expuestas a la IA. La agitación que sacudió los mercados bursátiles la semana pasada, ante el creciente temor de que la victoria aplastante de los demócratas en las elecciones de mitad de mandato en Estados Unidos pudiera poner en peligro la vasta infraestructura de centros de datos que sustenta la inteligencia artificial, dejó a pocos mercados quietos. Tras la caída del 6,4% que sufrió el índice Nasdaq 100 el jueves, las acciones de Japón, Corea y Taiwán se vieron arrastradas al día siguiente. El índice de referencia surcoreano, con fuerte presencia tecnológica —que se recuperó en el primer semestre gracias a la afluencia de inversores minoristas que perseguían el impulso alcista—, se hundió hasta su nivel más bajo desde marzo. Incluso las acciones suizas, que destacan por su limitada exposición a la IA, registraron en un momento dado su mayor caída en ocho meses. Ver más: Google reta a Nvidia con chips de IA casi 30% más baratos y clientes como Apple, Meta y Anthropic Al mismo tiempo, la dispersión de los rendimientos del viernes pone de relieve cómo algunos sectores de los mercados emergentes se han visto protegidos de las repercusiones de la IA. Alrededor del 30% de las acciones del índice MSCI subieron el viernes, el doble de la proporción del S&P 500 que registró ganancias el día anterior, cuando este se desplomó un 4,4%. A medida que los inversores se mostraban cada vez más recelosos ante los altos niveles de concentración de los índices, los fondos pasivos registraron en octubre una salida de capitales por primera vez en tres años, según Toni Meadows, director de inversiones de BRI Wealth Management. “Esto también es un indicio de rotación, ya que aleja el dinero de los índices bursátiles concentrados”, afirmó. Los mercados emergentes han sufrido sus propias crisis específicas en los últimos meses, que van desde un escándalo de manipulación de fondos en Turquía hasta la amenaza de MSCI de excluir a Indonesia de su índice de referencia y la caída de la bolsa que siguió a la sorprendente reelección de Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva el mes pasado. Sin embargo, la enorme brecha de valoración y la relativamente baja exposición a la IA en algunos sectores de los mercados emergentes están atrayendo a ciertos inversores. Las expectativas de políticas comerciales estadounidenses menos restrictivas tras el revés sufrido por el presidente Donald Trump en las elecciones de mitad de mandato también están impulsando este mercado. El índice de referencia de MSCI para países en desarrollo cotiza a unas 8 veces los beneficios previstos para los próximos 12 meses —menos de la mitad del múltiplo del S&P 500—, a pesar de ofrecer una rentabilidad por dividendo aproximadamente el doble, según muestran los datos recopilados por Bloomberg. El bajo múltiplo del MSCI se debe, en parte, a que los analistas han revisado al alza rápidamente sus previsiones de beneficios para los gigantes de la IA incluidos en el índice. “Muchos sectores y mercados no tecnológicos de los mercados emergentes ofrecen un crecimiento a largo plazo más sólido que sus homólogos estadounidenses, con múltiplos significativamente más atractivos”, afirmó Maxence Visseau, director de inversiones de Arkevium Capital en Dubái. Ver más: Citi rebaja su recomendación sobre acciones de EE.UU. por los riesgos de la IA y mejora la de Europa La rápida liquidación de las posiciones en IA la semana pasada provocó que miles de millones de dólares fluyeran hacia la India, que hasta hace poco se había quedado rezagada este año. El índice NSE Nifty 50 de la India subió un 2% el viernes, cerrando su mejor semana desde 2021, mientras que otros índices de referencia en Asia y Europa se encontraban en números rojos. Las entradas de capital en la renta variable del país se encaminaban a alcanzar un récord semanal, incluso cuando las valoraciones se han disparado en comparación con sus pares de mercados emergentes, lo que pone de manifiesto cómo los inversores están pagando un precio elevado por la protección frente a las turbulencias de la IA. “La inversión más obvia en contra de la IA debería ser en India”, afirmó Bing Yuan, gestora de fondos de Edmond de Rothschild, quien recientemente comenzó a invertir en este mercado, aunque se muestra cautelosa respecto a su sector dominante de servicios de TI. “Si se quiere abandonar la IA, debería ser una opción a considerar”. También posee acciones de empresas chinas del sector sanitario, como BeOne Medicines Ltd., que ha avanzado un 37% en 2026, y Wuxi Biologics Cayman Inc., que ha repuntado un 58%. Las acciones sudamericanas también están empezando a atraer a los inversores tras la dura ola de ventas que siguió a la victoria de Lula en Brasil frente a Flavio Bolsonaro, considerado por muchos como el candidato más favorable para los mercados. Ver más: Los banqueros se preparan para que la IA esté “presente en cada conversación” en la Cumbre sobre el Clima de Turquía “Latinoamérica es otra región que presenta una exposición mínima a la IA, un gran potencial de crecimiento y materias primas”, afirmó Malcolm Dorson, gestor sénior de cartera de Global X Management, con US$93.000 millones en activos bajo gestión en Estados Unidos. “La volatilidad de Brasil ha hecho que el listón para obtener un rendimiento superior sea extremadamente bajo”. Dorson ha estado asignando fondos a empresas mineras de cobre y oro, compañías de servicios públicos y bancos en toda la región. Robert Naess, gestor de cartera en Nordea Investment Management, ha estado reorientando sus inversiones hacia las telecomunicaciones y los bienes de consumo, comprando acciones de empresas como el fabricante chino de ropa deportiva Anta Sports Products Ltd. y el fabricante taiwanés de hardware informático Getac Holdings Corp. “Creo que la IA tendrá un gran impacto en la economía global, pero eso no significa necesariamente que las acciones de IA sean las mejores inversiones en el futuro”, dijo Naess, quien ayuda a supervisar US$1.100 millones en inversiones en mercados emergentes. Anthropic is seeking a valuation of about $1.4 trillion in its initial public offering, a bid to make history as the first frontier artificial intelligence lab to go public. The Claude chatbot maker and its co-founders are looking to raise as much as $90.4 billion in the IPO and a private placement. item.title: US House blocks bid to impeach Defense Secretary Hegseth
item.description: WASHINGTON: Republicans in the US House of Representatives blocked an effort on Tuesday (Nov 10) to impeach Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth, winning a reprieve for the polarising Pentagon chief before Democrats take control of Congress next year and possibly try again.
item.dc:creator: CNA

US House blocks bid to impeach Defense Secretary Hegseth

US Secretary of Defense Pete Hegseth holds a press briefing at the Pentagon in Washington, DC, US, Nov 10, 2026. (Photo: REUTERS/Evelyn Hockstein)

FAST

WASHINGTON: Republicans in the US House of Representatives blocked an effort on Tuesday (Nov 10) to impeach Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth, winning a reprieve for the polarising Pentagon chief before Democrats take control of Congress next year and possibly try again. The vote on a procedural motion came just hours after Hegseth blasted efforts to impeach him as a farce and delivered a defiant defence of his record at the helm of the US military, winning praise from President Donald Trump. The chamber voted 211 to 204 in favour of a motion to refer eight articles of impeachment to the Republican-led House Judiciary Committee, a move that the sponsor of the impeachment push, US Representative Thomas Massie, warned would kill it. Massie, an outgoing Kentucky Republican, had hoped to draw votes from Republicans upset with Hegseth's policies and wary of the unpopularity of the eight-month-old Iran war but no other Republicans joined him. The US-Israeli led conflict has never been approved by Congress, which is the only branch of government constitutionally permitted to declare war.

Democrats had voiced strong support for the impeachment articles, which accuse Hegseth of the "high crimes and misdemeanours" of illegally ordering the military to wage war in Iran and Yemen, attack boats in the Caribbean Sea and capture Venezuelan President Nicolas Maduro in January. But 11 Democrats, including former House Speaker Nancy Pelosi of California, did not vote. If eight of them had, the procedural measure would have been defeated, paving the way for a full House impeachment vote. Ian Krager, a spokesperson for Pelosi, said she had missed the vote because she had returned to San Francisco for an annual event to honour veterans, but would have voted against the procedural measure. Trump cheered the results in a social media post, saying the effort to impeach Hegseth "has miserably FAILED!" He wrote that Hegseth's performance on Iran, Venezuela and other issues "led to the EXONERATION of a Great American Patriot." Hegseth would have been the first US defence secretary to be impeached. The last time any civilian leader of the US military was impeached was in 1876, when William Belknap held the title "secretary of war". Hegseth calls himself secretary of war, part of his effort to rebrand a military he said was too weak and "woke" when he took office last year. Trump cannot change the name of the Defense Department without approval from Congress.

Related:

Trump vows comeback as bitter showdown with Congress looms

Trump revives election fraud claims after crushing midterm defeat

IRAN WAR ANGER Voter anger over the Iran war, which has settled into an effective stalemate focused on securing the Strait of Hormuz, helped Democrats win control of Congress in last week's midterm elections. A Reuters/Ipsos poll published on Tuesday found a majority of Americans want the newly elected Democratic-majority US Congress, which takes office in January, to act to end the war with Iran once and for all. Although Vice President JD Vance has publicly questioned the war and blamed it for the Republicans' midterm rout, he voiced support for Hegseth on Tuesday. "This isn't about Iran, this is about the fact that Pete took on the bureaucracy at the Pentagon," Vance wrote on social media. Before the vote, House Democratic leader Hakeem Jeffries said on Monday: "Pete Hegseth has abused his power, undermined America's national security, and he's the architect of the reckless and costly failed war of choice in Iran." Hegseth has repeatedly defended the conflict, calling Trump courageous and saying Iran's military has been left in ruins. He also said his orders to US forces were lawful, despite Massie's accusations of "high crimes and misdemeanours". "History will judge the Iran war quite differently than the conventional wisdom right now," Hegseth said on Tuesday at his first Pentagon briefing in six months. Jeffries said he would talk to members about whether to mount a new impeachment effort in the next Congress. "We'll have that conversation at the appropriate time," he said. A Democratic-led push to impeach Hegseth could be far more intense, with lawmakers calling in top brass to testify, including generals and admirals fired by Hegseth who have remained silent so far. Hegseth, who has railed against diversity efforts at the Pentagon, fired the chairman of the Joint Chiefs of Staff, who is Black, and the Navy's top admiral, a woman, among others. In such an effort, Democrats could also raise other issues of concern to voters including Pentagon policy toward Ukraine and the US military's strikes on suspected drug trafficking boats in Caribbean and Pacific waters. Some Republicans say Hegseth's strained relations with Congress are becoming a political liability as the Trump administration seeks a huge increase in the military's budget to US$1.5 trillion from US$950 billion. Massie said he was disappointed by the vote, comparing Republicans to passengers content to go down with the Titanic. "They know it's a sinking ship but committed to stay on board," he said.

Source: Reuters/fh/ec

item.title: The Musk Midterms Trade: SPCX Flat, TSLA Drops 5% but DOGE Plunges 7%
item.description: DOGEUSD is down 7% since the midterms, trailing both SpaceX NASDAQ:SPCX and Tesla NASDAQ:TSLA even though all three are tied to Elon Musk.Musk’s Three Assets Diverge After Election DayFrom the Nov. 3 ...
item.content:encoded:
News / Benzinga / The Musk Midterms Trade: SPCX Flat, TSLA Drops 5% but DOGE Plunges 7%

The Musk Midterms Trade: SPCX Flat, TSLA Drops 5% but DOGE Plunges 7% 1 min read

DOGEUSD SPCX TSLA ETHUSD Dogecoin DOGEUSD is down 7% since the midterms, trailing both SpaceX SPCX and Tesla TSLA even though all three are tied to Elon Musk . Musk’s Three Assets Diverge After Election Day From the Nov. 3 close through Nov. 9, SpaceX gained 0.50%, Tesla fell 5%, and Dogecoin dropped 7%, according to official sources. The selloff deepened Nov. 5, when Tesla and SpaceX shed roughly $456 billion combined, with SpaceX down 9% and Tesla down 12% on fears a Democratic Congress could slow their AI data center buildout and a rumored merger. SpaceX then rebounded nearly 15% through Nov. 9, erasing its losses entirely, while Tesla recovered 10% but stayed below its pre-election level. However, Dogecoin never turned the corner. Analysts Split Tesla and SpaceX’s Political Risk As Benzinga reported, a Bitunix analyst argued Tesla and SpaceX face different political risks following Texas Democrat Gina Hinojosa’s midterm win, with expansion plans, not existing operations, representing the real concern. That distinction may help explain why investors treated the two Musk companies differently once the initial selloff passed. SpaceX’s own earnings gave investors an additional reason to look past the political overhang. Benzinga reported the company posted third-quarter revenue of $14.58 billion, beating the $12.74 billion analysts expected, with earnings of 35 cents per share against estimates of 12 cents. Revenue climbed 161% year over year, fueled by SpaceX’s Super Intelligence segment. Why Dogecoin Never Found Its Own Catalyst Dogecoin had no earnings report, merger speculation or AI revenue story to anchor a recovery, leaving it exposed to broader crypto weakness instead. As Benzinga reported this week, October CPI came in hotter than expected, pushing December Fed rate hike odds toward 77% and dragging Bitcoin, Ethereum ETHUSD and XRP XRPUSD lower alongside Dogecoin, pressure that compounded lingering fallout from the Binance hack still rattling crypto sentiment heading into the election. Disclaimer Preview Image: Shutterstock

FAST

TOKYO, Nov 11 : Japanese manufacturers' sentiment rose to its strongest level in more than five years in November as booming semiconductor demand underpinned broad-based optimism, while the non-manufacturers' mood hit its highest in over eight years, a Reuters monthly poll showed. The Reuters Tankan sentiment index for manufacturers rose to plus-27 in November, the highest reading since August 2021, from plus-22 in October. The poll, a leading indicator of the Bank of Japan's quarterly Tankan business survey, was conducted from October 27 to November 6 and received responses from 214 of 508 firms. The indexes are calculated by subtracting the percentage of pessimistic responses from optimistic ones, with positive figures indicating net optimism. The improvement in manufacturers' confidence was led by the electronics sector, where sentiment jumped to plus-39 in November from plus-25.

"Semiconductor demand, particularly for memory, is very strong," a manager at an electronics machinery company said. Sentiment in the precision machinery sector, which includes some chip-related equipment makers, also improved to plus-42 from plus-38. "Orders from both domestic and international remain robust," said a manager at a precision machinery company. Another respondent at a machinery firm said that product shipments for the semiconductor market have reached an "unprecedented level". Oil refinery and ceramics rose to plus-25 from plus-14, while chemicals improved to plus-33 from plus-27. The non-manufacturers' index surged to plus-35 in November from plus-23 to reach a level not seen since June 2018. Sentiment in information and communications rose to plus-29 from plus-8 thanks to strong orders. Services and others rose strongly to plus-43 in November from plus-19. One manager said that "tight labour market conditions persist among companies, keeping demand for talent at a high level." Looking three months ahead, manufacturers expect sentiment to edge up to plus-28 in February, while non-manufacturers see confidence easing to plus-29. Rising prices and higher interest rates weighed on both sectors, the survey found, with some firms struggling to pass on increased costs to customers.

Source: Reuters

item.title: Over 100 Indonesian lawmakers sign petition that could lead to vice president's impeachment
item.description: Read more about Over 100 Indonesian lawmakers sign petition that could lead to vice president's impeachment on Devdiscourse ...
item.content:encoded:
Over 100 Indonesian lawmakers sign petition that could lead to vice president's impeachment Reuters | Updated: 11-11-2026 12:09 IST | Created: 11-11-2026 12:09 IST

SHARE

Key Takeaways AI Summary

Analyzing article...

More than 100 Indonesian lawmakers signed a petition on Wednesday that opens the door for the impeachment of Vice President Gibran Rakabuming Raka, a move that risks further stoking political tensions in Southeast Asia's largest economy. Gibran, the son of former president Joko Widodo, has come under intense scrutiny following rulings last month by the Constitutional Court and the Supreme Court saying that his education documents did not meet election requirements. The controversy has unfolded amid a widening rift between Widodo, also known as Jokowi, and the current President Prabowo Subianto, fuelling speculation over Gibran's political future. Gibran stated his intention to resign during a meeting with Prabowo on Tuesday. Over 100 lawmakers from several parties in parliament have signed a petition stating that Gibran is not eligible for office because the court rulings mean he "no longer meets the requirements as VP candidate," said Muhammad Kholid, one of the lawmakers signing the petition. The petition will be submitted to the House speaker, Kholid told Reuters, adding that the formal declaration of the lawmakers' position on the issue would lead into the impeachment process. The Supreme Court said in a ruling published on its website late on Tuesday that it was instructing the education ministry to withdraw Gibran's education equivalence certificate, which the court has annulled. Gibran, who studied abroad, used the certificate to comply with education requirements and run in the 2024 election, which he won alongside Prabowo. Indonesian election law requires vice-presidential candidates to have completed senior high school or an equivalent level of education, but the court found that the certificate was issued based on evidence that did not actually prove Jokowi's eldest son had graduated. "No evidence was found to show Gibran had a foreign diploma or certificate that could serve as the basis for equivalency with a senior high school or equivalent qualification," the court said in the ruling. The Supreme Court also took into account the Constitutional Court's ruling, which said Gibran's education documents did not meet election requirements. Sana Jaffrey, a researcher at Australian National University, said it would be difficult to imagine that lawmakers will move against Gibran without Prabowo's awareness or approval. "Prabowo's silence suggests that he wants Gibran’s removal without bearing the potential political cost of openly engineering it, particularly a possible backlash from Jokowi supporters whose backing helped secure his victory," she said. She said the crisis shows how the political fortunes of a small number of elites take precedence over the country’s need for effective and stable governance. "Prolonged uncertainty at the highest levels of power will only deepen anxieties at home and abroad about where the country is headed," she said.

FAST

NEW YORK, Nov 10 : The US Securities and Exchange Commission said on Tuesday it completed distributions from a $40 million fund created from civil fines paid by Elon Musk and his electric vehicle company Tesla to resolve the regulator's first civil enforcement case against the world's richest person. In a filing in Manhattan federal court, the SEC asked a federal judge to close the Fair Fund, created after Musk settled the SEC case in 2018 charging him with securities fraud for posting on August 7, 2018, that he had "funding secured" to potentially take Tesla private. His posts on Twitter that day caused Tesla's shares and trading volume to spike, with the shares closing more than 6 per cent higher than when he began posting. They later fell after it became clear Musk had not lined up financing. Musk and Tesla each paid a $20 million civil fine, with sums designated for investor victims of the alleged fraud. Neither defendant admitted wrongdoing. Musk also agreed to let Tesla lawyers review some Twitter posts in advance, and give up his role as chairman.

The SEC said a claims administrator distributed $41.53 million, including interest and after deducting fees, to 3,350 eligible claimants. Those claimants received 51.7 per cent of their approved claims because their losses exceeded the Fair Fund's size. Another 3,046 claims were rejected. The SEC said the approximately $449,000 remaining in the Fair Fund will go to the US Treasury. "Distribution of the Fair Fund is now complete," the SEC said. The case is separate from the SEC case accusing Musk of waiting 11 days too long in March and April 2022 to disclose his early purchases of Twitter shares. Musk settled that case by having a trust in his name pay $1.5 million, also without admitting wrongdoing. A federal judge approved that settlement in July, while expressing "significant misgivings" about whether the SEC let Musk off too easily. Musk is a former adviser to Republican US President Donald Trump. He bought Twitter in 2022, renamed it X, and later folded the social media platform into his rocket and satellite company SpaceX.

FAST

WASHINGTON, Nov 10 : The US Commodity Futures Trading Commission has warned prediction market startup Kalshi of imminent charges in a probe into whether it properly notified the agency about dozens of new products, a person familiar with the matter said on Tuesday. The regulator's notification to the company suggests the charges could come soon, said the person who requested anonymity because the decision is not yet public. Kalshi in a statement said the CFTC's warning "is about a procedural error involving the submission of a handful of contracts, many of which weren't live." "We are already addressing the issue," the company added.

The CFTC did not immediately respond to a Reuters request for comment. Kalshi has rapidly expanded its product offerings since securing a legal victory over the CFTC in 2024, allowing it to list diverse event-based derivatives. However, critics of prediction-market platforms such as Kalshi and peer Polymarket argue that the products resemble gambling and could encourage addictive behavior.  In recent months, Kalshi has pursued a broader strategy of competing with traditional exchange operators such as CME Group and New York Stock Exchange parent Intercontinental Exchange by expanding beyond event contracts into a range of asset classes through perpetual futures. Perpetual futures, often called "perps," are derivative contracts with no expiry date, allowing traders to hold positions indefinitely without rolling them over. They can also involve high leverage, increasing both potential gains and losses.  The company raised $1 billion at a $40 billion valuation late last month, co-led by Sequoia and Wellington, underscoring the growing popularity of such markets and strong institutional interest. Politico reported about the imminent charges earlier in the day.

item.title: World shares rise after technology shares advance on Wall Street ahead of U.S. inflation data
item.description: Global markets were higher Tuesday after U.S. stocks rallied, recovering most of their big losses from last week, while investors awaited U.S. inflation data for October.
item.dc:creator: The Associated Press
item.content:encoded: NEW YORK — The U.S. stock market dipped Tuesday after a report showed inflation was worse across the country last month than economists expected. The S&P 500 slipped 0.4 per cent and gave back some of its big rally from the day before. The Dow Jones Industrial Average dropped 157 points, or 0.3 per cent, and the Nasdaq composite sank 0.7 per cent. Pressure from the bond market undercut stocks following the discouraging report on inflation. People had to pay prices for groceries, electricity and other costs of living that were higher last month than economists expected. That could push the Federal Reserve to hike its main interest rate at its next meeting in December and beyond. Higher interest rates can help rein in inflation, but they do so by making it more expensive for everyone to borrow money and by slowing the overall economy. Higher rates also make investors less willing to pay high prices for stocks and other investments. One Fed official even hinted the central bank may increase the federal funds rate by double the typical amount next month because of how high inflation has remained for years. Speaking in London before the inflation report was released, Fed Gov. Christopher Waller said “a stronger policy move may be needed” if the report showed an important underlying measure of inflation rose by 0.3 per cent from September. In that case, he said the Fed should consider hiking the federal funds rate by half a percentage point rather than the typical quarter point. Moving by only the usual amount could “put our credibility at risk, a risk I am not eager to take.” Shortly afterward, Tuesday’s inflation report showed that the underlying measure of inflation Waller was worried about was exactly 0.3 per cent, the threshold he had set. It’s the Fed’s job to keep inflation under control, along with keeping the job market strong. That sent yields jumping in the bond market as traders upped their forecasts for coming hikes to rates by the Fed. The yield on the 10-year Treasury leaped to 4.99 per cent from 4.88 per cent late Monday. It’s a notable move for the bond market, and the yield helps set where rates are for mortgages and other loans going to U.S. households and businesses. The 10-year Treasury yield had been dropping since early October, when it topped 5.30 per cent as worries spiked about high inflation, higher interest rates, the U.S. government’s big debt and other concerns. Tuesday’s jump in yields came even though oil prices fell again. The price for a barrel of Brent crude oil fell 1.2 per cent to US$91.49. President Donald Trump said late Monday that the war in Iran, which sent oil prices much higher, “militarily is effectively over.” Brent’s price has been falling from more than US$112 at the start of the month amid uncertainty about what will happen with the war with Iran. Jumps in Treasury yields push downward on prices for all kinds of stocks, and they can particularly hurt companies in the real-estate business. Higher mortgage rates can keep potential customers away from homebuilders, for example, and Lennar fell 5.4 per cent for one of the sharper losses in the S&P 500. Rival homebuilders also fell, including drops of 3.8 per cent for D.R. Horton and 3.9 per cent for PulteGroup. Builders FirstSource, which sells crown mouldings, cabinets and other products to homebuilders, sank 4.6 per cent. The single heaviest weight on the S&P 500 was Nvidia, which fell 5.5 per cent. It’s been under pressure since its board announced an investigation into its CEO, Jensen Huang, who admitted to a relationship with a woman who, according to The New York Times, U.S. intelligence determined was gathering information for China. It’s also been swinging amid broader worries that have knocked the artificial-intelligence industry around recently. Democratic victories in statehouses across the country last week raised concerns about possible restrictions on construction of AI data centres. That built on top of longstanding worries that AI stock prices had shot too high and were in a bubble. GE Vernova, which is helping to power AI data centres, dropped 3.9 per cent. Micron Technology, which sells memory for computers, fell 1.1 per cent. CoreWeave, a company that rents out access to AI chips to customers over the cloud, slipped 0.5 per cent. Other AI-related stocks held up better, though. Broadcom climbed 3.9 per cent, and Advanced Micro Devices rose 1.3 per cent. The recent shakiness for AI-related stocks had raised questions about whether Anthropic, the company behind the Claude chatbot, may delay its initial public offering of stock. But Anthropic said in a filing with U.S. regulators on Tuesday that it’s looking to sell its stock at a price valuing the company at roughly US$1.3 trillion. That would make it one of the most valuable companies on Wall Street, worth more than Walmart, JPMorgan Chase, ExxonMobil or Coca-Cola. All told, the S&P 500 fell 29.01 points to 7,520.93. The Dow Jones Industrial Average dipped 157.86 to 52,231.89, and the Nasdaq composite sank 187.26 to 25,065.87. In stock markets abroad, indexes rose across much of Europe and Asia. South Korea’s Kospi jumped 4.4 per cent for one of the world’s biggest gains on strength for its two tech giants that have benefited from the AI boom, Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix. ___ Stan Choe, The Associated Press AP Writers Elaine Lai and Matt Ott contributed to this report

FAST

LONDON, Nov 10 : British horse racing's welfare board on Tuesday unveiled a five-year strategy that will use AI, wearable technology and lifetime tracking of horses to prevent injuries, reduce falls and improve horses' well-being away from the racetrack. The new strategy sets out 20 priorities to improve welfare and safety of thoroughbred horses throughout their lives, spanning areas including veterinary research, injury prevention, the training environment and aftercare and extending the scope of oversight from foaling through training to life after racing. Horse racing is Britain's second most-watched sport but concern for equine welfare remains its biggest reputational challenge, with falls, fatalities and the treatment of horses at key racing festivals like Cheltenham and Aintree under constant public scrutiny. Fatality rates in jumps racing were largely unchanged at 0.47 per cent in 2025 even after measures to improve the safety of fences like changing the colour of markings in 2022.

The British Horseracing Authority says it extended the scope of its reporting to cover more horses in 2021 and that it would take time for the safety improvements to take full effect. The rate of fallers dropped below 2 per cent on a five-year average for the first time in 2025, BHA data shows.  Work to improve safety and reduce fatalities is ongoing and a priority for the sport, Minette Batters, independent chair of the Horse Welfare Board, told reporters. "It's never going to be a case of accepting fatalities," she said. "It's what can we continue to do to make the sport safer that sits front and centre of everything we're doing."  Collecting more data on all aspects of a horse's life will enable trainers, vets and racecourse officials to spot issues like weakness or heart problems before they lead to on-racecourse injuries, racing experts said. This can start as early as birth by educating breeders on how antibiotic use in foals can impact soundness or in training by using heart monitors and wearable tech to detect equine illness or underperformance. "We're standing at the beginnings of a technology revolution in training of horses, in management of horses," said Fred Barrelet, veterinary surgeon and independent member of the Horse Welfare Board. "It's also becoming accepted and part of the young next generation of trainers and breeders' repertoire and armoury for managing their horses." The strategy also includes an ambition to track the full lifetime of all horses bred for racing in Britain through the Retraining of Racehorses programme.

Source: Reuters

Israel's parliament sworn in as Eisenkot tries to forge a government

Israeli President Isaac Herzog urged lawmakers to "do everything to avoid another election”.

Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu, and lawmaker Gadi Eisenkot, pose for a group photo after the swearing-in ceremony for Israeli lawmakers at the Knesset, Israel's parliament, in Jerusalem, on Nov 10, 2026. (Photo: AP/Ohad Zwigenberg)

FAST

JERUSALEM: Israel 's parliament was sworn in on Tuesday (Nov 10) without a new government , after a deadlocked general election stripped Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu of his parliamentary majority but left his main rivals with no clear path to power. Lawmakers elected in the Oct 27 vote took their oaths of office as Gadi Eisenkot , a former general, sought to forge a coalition after Israel 's president tasked him on Sunday with forming a government . Eisenkot and his allies also lack a majority and he has yet to strike deals with parties that could bring him to power. If both Eisenkot and Netanyahu fail to form coalitions, another election could follow. Presiding over the swearing-in ceremony, President Isaac Herzog told lawmakers: "You must do everything to avoid a repeat election."

"Reach out a hand for compromise, even between rivals ... Look upon one another with generosity. There is much work to be done here, and it requires the ability and experience found in every part of this House."

PARLIAMENT COULD TRY TO SET UP OCT 7 INQUIRY Netanyahu remains caretaker prime minister until a new candidate manages to form a coalition. His right-wing Likud party's alliance with far-right and ultra-Orthodox parties outperformed election expectations but still lost its majority, now holding 53 of the Knesset's 120 seats. Eisenkot's centre-right Yashar party and patchwork partner factions hold just 48 seats. But they have potential allies in Israel 's Arab-led parties, which hold 19 seats and are aligned with Eisenkot in their vehement opposition to Netanyahu . This means that the newly sworn-in parliament could still deliver on some of Eisenkot's campaign promises, such as potentially setting up a commission of inquiry into the Oct 7, 2023 Hamas attacks, something backed by the Arab parties but largely opposed by Netanyahu . It also could allow Eisenkot to replace the current Knesset speaker, a Likud member. Herzog told Knesset members that parliament was "duty bound to leave no stone unturned" in investigating and understanding the "catastrophe" of Oct 7, while Israel continues to face threats from Iran and its proxies. Eisenkot initially has until Dec 6 to form a government but he can seek a two-week extension to Dec 20. He has acknowledged his path to power is "extraordinarily complex". His options include trying to form a minority government with Arab party support, bringing ultra-Orthodox parties into his camp despite years of mutual hostility, or forging a unity government with Netanyahu . All three paths face formidable obstacles. Ultra-Orthodox parties have so far said they would not join an Eisenkot-led government .

Related:

How Israel's new parliament can make Netanyahu's life difficult

Netanyahu rival Eisenkot seeks 'wide' government but path to power uncertain

Israel faces new era of sinking US support after election

For his part, Netanyahu has cast doubt on the election results by baselessly alleging voter fraud by Arabs, who make up a fifth of the population. Election officials have said they are probing potential misconduct, but that they have seen no evidence of fraud that could have influenced the vote's outcome. Speaking after parliament was sworn in, Netanyahu called for a unity government , warning that Iran was seeking to revive its nuclear programme and that Israel could come under growing international pressure to accept a nuclear-armed Iran. "Only such a (unity) government will be capable of confronting challenges of this magnitude," he said. If Eisenkot fails to form a government , Herzog would likely ask Netanyahu to try to build a coalition. If he also fails, another candidate would get a chance before Israel would be forced into another election. Moments after the official opening of parliament, Eisenkot and his allies submitted a series of bills, including legislation to establish a state commission of inquiry into the Oct 7 attacks and to impose term limits on the prime minister. They also proposed repealing a controversial judicial overhaul and other laws enacted under Netanyahu 's government over the past four years. Among those sworn in on Tuesday was Elisha Madan, a military reservist who lost both legs fighting in Gaza. He received a standing ovation from lawmakers as he rose on his prosthetic legs to take the oath of office.

Source: Reuters/fs

FAST

Nov 10 : Nscale, a British cloud provider backed by chip giant Nvidia, is considering delaying a $35 billion stock market listing, the Telegraph reported on Tuesday. Executives at the data-centre developer are assessing whether to pause efforts to go public until next year, the report added. Nscale did not immediately respond to a Reuters request for comment outside regular business hours. The report comes days after Reuters reported that Microsoft had declined an option to expand its existing agreement with Nscale to rent more computing power at a Texas data center.

The news about Nscale's IPO comes as Anthropic moves ahead with its own listing plans. The AI giant on Tuesday filed an updated prospectus for its IPO, seeking a valuation of up to $1.4 trillion, slightly short of some investors' expectations. Anthropic's IPO is seen as a key test of Wall Street's faith in the AI boom it helped ignite.

item.title: Further interest rate hikes might be needed: Bank of Canada
item.description: The Bank of Canada’s governing council thinks it might need to raise interest rates further, but it’s proceeding carefully, according to a summary of deliberations.
item.dc:creator: The Canadian Press
item.content:encoded: OTTAWA — The Bank of Canada’s governing council thinks it might need to raise interest rates further, but it’s proceeding carefully, according to a summary of deliberations of its recent decision to raise its key policy rate for the first time since 2023. According to the report, the council acknowledged it faced considerable uncertainty and said it would take its monetary policy decisions one meeting at a time. The Bank of Canada raised its policy interest rate by a quarter of a percentage point to 2.5 per cent last month to reduce the risk that stubbornly high oil prices become persistent inflation. The summary says the council members agreed that monetary policy cannot lower global energy prices, but can prevent them from leading to generalized inflation. The decision came as the Bank of Canada raised its outlook for the annual inflation rate to hit 3.5 per cent at the end of this year and remain above three per cent for much of 2027. The summary of deliberations said higher costs largely haven’t been passed through to consumers so far, but the bank’s surveys suggest businesses expect to raise some prices over the next year. --- This report by The Canadian Press was first published Nov. 10, 2026.
